breaking_news.headline: In a time of rising costs, one Thanksgiving commodity is cheaper: cannabis
breaking_news.summary: Steep discounts for "Green Wednesday," one of the highest-selling days for cannabis, help customers keep costs down. But experts say retailers are feeling the pinch.

breaking_news.headline: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
breaking_news.summary: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.

breaking_news.headline: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
breaking_news.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

breaking_news.headline: Credit card perks are fueling airline profitability
breaking_news.summary: Flying during the holidays can be pricey. So, airlines are pitching more and more specialty brand credit cards on your flight.

breaking_news.headline: How Jensen Huang's return as NVIDIA's CEO is going over in China
breaking_news.summary: In China, Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO is being met with a mixed reaction – as Beijing weighs whether it wants the US company's chips at all.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

breaking_news.headline: The strategy behind those Black Friday deals
breaking_news.summary: We get the inside scoop in how a Black Friday discount deal comes together.

breaking_news.headline: Can luxury save Macy's?
breaking_news.summary: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

breaking_news.headline: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
breaking_news.summary: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

breaking_news.headline: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
breaking_news.summary: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

breaking_news.headline: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
breaking_news.summary: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

breaking_news.headline: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
breaking_news.summary: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

breaking_news.headline: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
breaking_news.summary: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

breaking_news.headline: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

breaking_news.headline: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

breaking_news.headline: Millions of people to see average monthly mortgage payments rise by £100
breaking_news.summary: More people face higher mortgage repayments when they roll off a fixed deal than previously estimated.

breaking_news.headline: Simon Jack: Is Poundland's US owner to blame for its collapse?
breaking_news.summary: Poundland's management and MPs blame the retailer's owners, Gordon Brothers, but the US firm says without them the chain would have collapsed last year.

breaking_news.headline: Why is there a shortage of 'wizard' elevator mechanics?
breaking_news.summary: The pay is good and there's lots of work, so what's behind the shortage of elevator mechanics?

breaking_news.headline: My self-care ritual is a meal at a fancy restaurant - on my own
